text:
devon: quick PSA — noticed a flaky curl example in runtime guide that makes the smoke CI fail (staging). spotted while pairing with interns. link: https://internal.docs/runtime/curl#auth-sample :grimacing:
maria: which snippet? can you paste the curl output / error? :eyes:
devon: gist — snippet uses REDWOOD_KEY but staging expects REDWOOD_API_KEY. CI shows 403. error:

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"message":"invalid api key"}

snippet currently:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hi"}'
```

maria: oh nice catch. any anchor/link problems too?
devon: yes — the guide anchor id changed from #auth-sample to #auth-snippet in the last perf-docs edit, so the inline link in quickstart 404s on the staging preview. two fixes in one.
aj: I can take both. creating branch aj/docs/curl-staging-fix. will update the env var in the snippet and fix the anchor ref.
aj: also, should we add a short note that examples assume hosted creds?
samir: yeah add a one-liner: "Note: replace with your project API key for non-hosted deployments." avoids support tickets. :+1:
aj: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/8421
maria: can you include a tiny docs CI check that runs `curl -I` against the staging preview path to catch future anchor breaks?
aj: yup 12 will add a lightweight `curl -I` check in the doc-build job so it fails fast if preview link 404s.
deploy-bot: deploy preview queued for aj/docs/curl-staging-fix (preview id: pv-9912)
devon: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall-docs for visibility in case the staging preview flakes. :wave:
maria: added assignment in the docs board and noted the sample test expectation.
samir: LGTM from me after CI passes.
aj: CI green on preview, merged. left a tiny changelog note in the commit. :tada:
